name: intellig
description: IntelliJ IDEA-style Git workflows for VS Code

Accept My Changes for All Conflicts

Compare with the Same Repository Version

intellig.defaultRepo.description: Repository basename or absolute path to use by default in multi-root workspaces. When empty, IntelliG uses the repo containing the active editor when unambiguous, otherwise prompts.

enumDescriptions: Stock VS Code keybindings — IntelliG binds no keyboard shortcuts.

IntelliJ IDEA-style Git keybindings (Ctrl+K commit, Ctrl+Shift+K push, Alt+` VCS popup, and the rest — see the Keyboard Shortcuts editor). Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A (blame) is an IntelliG convenience without an IntelliJ default.
intellig.keymapPreset.markdownDescription:
Keyboard shortcut preset. `intellij` applies IntelliJ IDEA-style Git keybindings — the full table is on the extension's Feature Contributions page and in the Keyboard Shortcuts editor (search `intellig`).

**Note:** with the `intellij` preset on, `Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Z` performs **Revert File** — a destructive on-disk revert. Unstage Selected is a distinct chord (`Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Shift+Z`).

intellig.protectedBranches.description: Branches for which destructive operations are guarded: Reset modes Hard/Keep are disabled, and the Push dialog disables 'Force Push (Anyway)' (bare --force) when the target matches. '--force-with-lease' remains available. Remove a branch from this list to enable the guarded operations.

intellig.autorefresh.description: Automatically refresh the Git views (Local Changes, status bar) when files change in the working tree. Turn off to only refresh on Git operations and manual reloads.

intellig.addCherryPickedFromSuffix.description: Append '(cherry picked from commit <hash>)' to the message when cherry-picking an already-published commit (git cherry-pick -x). Commits not yet on any remote are never annotated.

intellig.useCommitToolWindow.description: Show the Commit tool window (Local Changes + Shelf tabs, directory grouping, Unversioned Files node, diff preview, before-commit checks) in the IntelliG panel. When disabled, the Ctrl+K shortcut opens the classic modal Commit dialog instead.

intellig.commitAuthor.description: Default author override in 'Name <email>' format. Leave empty to use git config.

intellig.commitMessageIssueLinks.description: Detect issue/PR references (e.g. #42, GH-101, PROJ-7) in commit messages and render them as clickable links to the configured hosting provider.

intellig.warnAboutCrlf.description: Warn before committing files with CRLF line separators when core.autocrlf is not normalizing. The warning offers fixing core.autocrlf or committing as-is.

intellig.largeFileWarningMb.description: Warn before committing files larger than this size in MB (large blobs stay in history forever and most hosts refuse them). Set 0 to disable the check.

intellig.useTabbedGitToolWindow.description: Show a tabbed Git tool window (Log / Console / Incoming / Update Info / History). Enabled by default; disable to restore the single Log panel.

intellig.log.showAllRoots.description: Show commits from all workspace repositories merged into one log (matches the branch view, which shows all repositories by default). A Root column marks each commit's repository with a colored stripe; hover for the name. Disable to scope a multi-repo workspace's log to a single repository.

intellig.log.showRootNames.description: In the merged multi-repository log, widen the Root column to show each repository's name on its color instead of the narrow stripe.

intellig.log.highlightCherryPicked.description: Dim commits that are already cherry-picked to the current branch's upstream and show a ✓ badge. Uses `git log --cherry-mark`. Turn off if you find the visual cue too busy.

intellig.log.showGpgColumn.description: Show a GPG/SSH signature status column in the commit log. Displays a glyph per commit: ✓ valid, ✗ bad/revoked, ⚠ expired/unknown, — missing key, empty for unsigned commits.

intellig.log.showLongEdges.description: Draw every graph edge at its full length. When off (the default), an edge spanning more than 30 rows is hidden through its middle and capped with a small arrow near each end, so a merge-heavy history doesn't grow the graph column to fill the panel. Turn on to always draw the whole line.

enumDescriptions: Follow git's default tag-fetching behavior (no --tags / --no-tags flag added).
Always pass --tags, fetching every tag regardless of reachability.
Always pass --no-tags, skipping tag fetch entirely.
intellig.fetchTags.description: Tag-fetching policy applied to every fetch (manual + auto-fetch). Explicit user-passed --tags / --no-tags options in programmatic callers override this setting.

intellig.pullRebase.description: Use rebase instead of merge when pulling

intellig.branches.showTags.description: Show the Tags section in the branches popup. Toggle from the popup's settings gear.

intellig.branches.showRecentBranches.description: Show the Recent section in the branches popup. Toggle from the popup's settings gear.

intellig.branches.groupByDirectory.description: Group branches that share a '/'-prefix (e.g. feature/*) with indentation in the branches popup. Toggle from the popup's settings gear.

intellig.blameAnnotationStyle.description: Style for blame annotations. 'inline' shows blame at end of the current line; 'gutter' shows blame in the gutter with background heat gradient; 'both' enables both; 'off' disables all blame annotations.

enumDescriptions: Tint blame lines by commit age — a heat gradient from oldest to newest.
Tint blame lines by a stable per-author color.
intellig.blame.colorMode.description: Background color mode for blame annotations. 'order' shades lines by commit age (heat gradient); 'author' assigns each author a stable color.

intellig.blame.showAuthor.description: Show the author column in blame annotations.

intellig.blame.showDate.description: Show the date column in blame annotations.

intellig.blame.showRevision.description: Show the revision (commit hash) column in blame annotations.

enumDescriptions: Show only the author's first name.
Show only the author's last name.
intellig.blame.authorNameFormat.description: How the author is displayed in blame annotations.

intellig.blame.ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore whitespace changes when computing Git blame (git blame -w).

enumDescriptions: Detect moved lines within the same file (git blame -M).
Detect lines moved or copied across files (git blame -C).
intellig.blame.detectMovements.description: How Git blame detects moved or copied lines.

enumDescriptions: Ignore all whitespace and whitespace-only lines (git --ignore-all-space --ignore-blank-lines).
intellig.diff.ignorePolicy.description: Whitespace ignore policy applied when generating diffs.

intellig.lineStatus.enabled.description: Show live changed-line markers (added/modified/deleted vs HEAD) in the editor gutter, updated as you type.

intellig.autoOpenResolveConflictsDialog.description: Automatically open the Resolve Conflicts dialog when a merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert/unshelve/unstash produces conflicts.

intellig.mergeWindow.enabled.description: Resolve conflicts in the IntelliG merge window — a three-pane editor (yours, result, theirs) with per-change apply/ignore controls and an editable result. Turn off to use VS Code's built-in merge editor instead.

intellig.mergeWindow.autoApplyNonConflic.description: Apply all non-conflicting changes automatically when the merge window opens, leaving only real conflicts to resolve. The same action is always available from the merge window toolbar.

intellig.shelve.removeAppliedFiles.description: When unshelving silently, remove successfully-applied files from the shelf entry. If all files apply cleanly, the entry is deleted.

intellig.repositoryScanMaxDepth.description: Maximum depth to scan workspace folders for nested git repositories. Set to -1 for unlimited (uses realpath cycle guard). Mirrors VS Code's git.repositoryScanMaxDepth setting.

intellig.repositoryScanIgnoredFolders.description: Additional folder names (basename) to skip when scanning for nested git repositories. The following are always excluded and cannot be overridden: .git, node_modules, .vscode, out, dist, .next, target, build, vendor.

intellig.log.level.description: Minimum severity admitted to the IntelliG logger. Records at lower levels are dropped before allocation.

intellig.log.console.description: When enabled, mirror IntelliG log records to the developer console (visible only in the Extension Development Host).
